title: Reducibility and complete reducibility of second-order elliptic difference Galois groups with non-torsion shift detected on the doubled period lattice
author: Thomas Dreyfus; Julien Roques
work: Galois Groups of Difference Equations of Order Two on Elliptic Curves
source_version: Official SIGMA 11 (2015) article 003, DOI 10.3842/SIGMA.2015.003; journal PDF and native TeX acquired 2026-10-01, exact bytes pinned by SHA256
difficulty_reason: The proof descends arbitrary elliptic-period Riccati solutions to the doubled lattice, including the scalar Galois case where infinitely many solutions occur. That case requires a cyclic extension norm calculation, Hilbert90 and constant cocycle diagonalization, followed by a second lattice descent; it is not merely the standard triangularization criterion.

source_check.note: The complete original main Riccati doubled-lattice criterion Theorem 4.4 and both directions of the author proof are retained. All new elliptic-field property(P) proof, full Riccati solution-number classification and cyclic scalar-case descent are supplied. The norm normalization, Hilbert 90 gauge, constant-cocycle diagonalization and second lattice descent handle infinitely many Riccati solutions, rather than stopping at the standard triangularization criterion. K remains the union of all sublattice meromorphic elliptic fields, and translation is non-torsion modulo Lambda. Van der Put–Singer reduction and the algebraic-subgroup classification are cited standard prerequisites. No imprimitivity, theta-divisor algorithm or discrete Lame application is counted. Existing approved human statement/proof/context/above-qualification decision copied from the frozen manifest and metadata; no new source or mathematical review.

proof_review.note: Complete Theorem4.4 and Lemma4.3 descent proof read, together with the full Riccati classification Lemma4.1 and new elliptic-field property(P) Proposition2.6. The base K is the union of meromorphic elliptic fields for all sublattices of Lambda, phi is translation by h non-torsion modulo Lambda, a in M_Lambda and b nonzero in M_Lambda. Prior van der Put-Singer group-reduction and the algebraic subgroup classification are published background. Neither the later Lame applications nor their parameter variants are counted.

original_metadata.statement_scope: Full Theorem4.4 for phi^2 y+a phi y+b y=0, a meromorphic Lambda-periodic, b a nonzero such function, phi translation by non-torsion h and K the union of all sublattice elliptic function fields. G reducible iff its Riccati equation has at least one solution in M_(2Lambda); G completely reducible iff at least two distinct solutions occur there.
